name: agrosmart
description: A full-stack web application using **MEAN Stack** (MongoDB, Express.js, Angular 21, Node.js) with a **Python ML microservice** that recommends optimal crops based on soil quality, weather conditions, and location. Includes real-time crop rate tracking across all 36 Indian States & UTs.

scripts.start: concurrently -n "ML,Backend,Frontend" -c "bgYellow.bold,bgGreen.bold,bgBlue.bold" "npm run start:ml" "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:frontend"
